Supervisor/Contact/Corresponding author: Victoria K. Cortessis and Nandor Gabor Than
Main topic of the publication: This paper analyzes high-dimensional RNA and protein data to characterize molecular features of complete hydatidiform moles (CHMs) and corresponding pathologic pathways, comparing them to first trimester placentas.
